name: N-[(4-bromophenyl)methyl]-2-(5-methoxy-1H-indol-3-yl)ethanamine
summary: 5-MeO-NBpBrT, also known as 5-methoxy-N-(4-bromobenzyl)tryptamine, is an N-substituted member of the 5-methoxytryptamine family of compounds. Like other such compounds, it acts as an antagonist for the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor, with a claimed 100-fold selectivity over the closely related serotonin 5-HT2C receptor.

pharmacology.text: Like other such compounds, it acts as an antagonist for the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor, with a claimed 100-fold selectivity over the closely related serotonin 5-HT2C receptor. Extending the benzyl group to a substituted phenethyl can also recover agonist activity in certain cases.

uses.en: It is used only in laboratory research and is not a medicine.
uses.zh: 它僅用於實驗室研究，並不是藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它仅用于实验室研究，并不是药物。

fact.en: Adding a benzyl group to the nitrogen usually turns phenethylamines into strong 5-HT2A activators, as in the NBOMes. In this tryptamine, the same kind of change produces a blocker instead.
fact.zh: 在氮原子上加苄基，通常會讓苯乙胺類變成很強的 5-HT2A 活化劑，例如 NBOMe 類。但在這個色胺上，同樣的改變反而產生了阻斷劑。
fact.zhHans: 在氮原子上加苄基，通常会让苯乙胺类变成很强的 5-HT2A 活化剂，例如 NBOMe 类。但在这个色胺上，同样的改变反而产生了阻断剂。
